PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Authenticated player bankroll, active free spin vault state, and lifetime slot statistics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the player account menu.

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

freeSpinsLeft.description: Remaining free spins in the current bonus round.

freeSpinPot.description: Accumulated bonus winnings waiting for end-of-bonus collection.

freeSpinsPlayed.description: Number of free spins played in the current bonus round.

totalSpins.description: Lifetime spins completed by the player.

biggestWin.description: Largest single spin or bonus round payout.

lastDailyBonusAt.description: Server timestamp of the last claimed 24-hour daily login bonus.

dailyBonusStreak.description: Consecutive daily login bonus streak count.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last player state sync.

WithdrawalRequest.title: WithdrawalRequest
WithdrawalRequest.description: Player GCash payout request submitted with coin-to-peso tier conversion for admin processing.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting player.

playerName.description: Display name of the requesting player.

playerEmail.description: Optional email address of the requesting player.

gcashName.description: GCash account name of the claimant.

gcashNumber.description: Philippine mobile number registered to GCash.

coinsAmount.description: Amount of coins deducted for this withdrawal tier.

status.description: Admin processing state for the payout request.

adminNote.description: Optional reference or rejection note added by an admin.

processedBy.description: UID of the admin who processed the payout.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the withdrawal was requested.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest status update.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was recorded.

/players/{userId}.description: Per-user private slot vault storing bankroll, active free spin pot state, and stats.

/withdrawals/{withdrawalId}.description: GCash withdrawal payout requests submitted by players and managed by admins.
